text:
vic: heads-up — added a tiny Next starter that demonstrates LlamaIndex + Redwood embeddings for docs search. noticed a confusing auth/retry + serializer interplay that causes index rebuilds on client nav. repo: https://git.company/oss/next-docs-starter
rachel: can you summarize the failure mode quickly?
vic: flow: server builds index during SSR and persists snapshot to KV. client calls an edge /api/embed which should reuse snapshot. instead the edge loader errors with "unsupported snapshot format" and falls back to rebuilding the index (expensive).
ci-bot: recorded SDKs: server: @redwood/inference@0.15.0, edge runtime shim uses 0.14.3 due to base image pin in CI
omar: yep that mismatch will do it. any auth logs? sometimes token rotation mid-request can trigger a rebuild if persist fails.
vic: logs show a 401 refresh once during rollout but mostly 200s. snippet:
```
2026-03-25T11:02:12Z INFO kv.get docs-site/snap size=170kb
2026-03-25T11:02:12Z WARN auth.refresh retry=1 code=401
2026-03-25T11:02:12Z ERROR index.load UnsupportedSnapshotError: format v0f
```
tess: workaround we used in another starter: explicit serializer arg on persist/load and pin exact SDK in package.json for both server and edge bundles. also add a postinstall validator that inspects lockfile for @redwood/inference version parity.
rachel: agree — that's a great DX mitigation. can we also put a dev-time validator during startup that checks snapshot roundtrip (persist->load) and prints a clear error with remediation steps instead of a cryptic loader error?
omar: +1. add an e2e that does SSR persist -> edge load and asserts no fallback rebuild (we can check build traces). CI quickcheck should catch regressions across SDK bumps.
vic: I'll draft a PR that includes: (1) pinned dependency, (2) example using idx.persist({serializer:'json.v1'}) and loadIndex(...,{serializer:'json.v1'}), (3) postinstall parity check script, (4) small Jest e2e harness that asserts snapshot roundtrip. tagging @tess for review.
tess: thanks — also include brief README notes about runtime boundaries (Vercel edge vs Node server) and auth token rotation recommendations for long-running pages.
rachel: marking as medium DX. please flag if we should backport validator to other starters after PR merges.
vic: will do. PR incoming. :rocket:
